name: branding-monoline-dog-symbol-with-pet-packaging
title: One-line dog head symbol with treat bags and paper carrier
whatItIs: A white slide with a single continuous black line drawing of a dog head with two dots for eyes and a solid round nose, above two application photos: resealable treat pouches in acid yellow, terracotta and aubergine with the dog symbol and bold serif type, and a white paper bag on asphalt with hand-lettered 'Woof' curling into the symbol.
whatItMeans: Cute, witty and warm; the single stroke feels affectionate and hand-made.
techniques: Draw a mascot in one continuous stroke with a solid dot for emphasis.
Vary the mark's scale and rotation across pack graphics.
Combine fat retro serif with the line-art symbol.
Let hand-lettering flow into the mascot on a bag.

vocabulary.definition: A drawing made with one unbroken stroke.
A logo built from a character.
Custom-drawn text instead of a typeface.
